aboutPage.title: about
aboutPage.bioText: kotakunp is a Vocaloid music producer and software developer. Blending synthetic voices with emotion, code with creativity. Building songs and tools that inspire expression.
aboutPage.philosophyText: I believe in the quiet power of sound and code. Technology is a means—emotion is the purpose. I create with intention, iterate with curiosity, and share to connect.
